title: Connecticut Parachutists Inc
specs: Jump from up to 14,000 ft with views of Long Island Sound, CT River, and Hartford
Operates a Cessna Caravan April through November for up to 12 jumpers
Over 50 years of operation at Ellington Airport, CT's longest running dropzone
Staff includes USPA certified instructors and world-class skydiving champions
Maximum allowable weight 230 lbs; individuals over 210 lbs charged additional $20 fee
Must have A license to jump during winter operations; no AFF or coach jumps in winter
Group discounts available for 5-14 and 15+ jumpers

options.name: Standard Video Package
options.detail: Video and photos by a freefall photographer including pre-jump interview, exit/freefall footage, and landing.

options.name: Ultimate Video Package
options.detail: Deluxe video including both handcam and outside video capturing all angles from pre-flight to landing.

options.name: Group Discount 15+ Jumpers
options.detail: Group of 15 or more jumpers pay $265 per person; cannot be combined with other discounts.

options.name: Tandem Skydive
options.detail: Tandem jump from up to 14,000 ft at CT's longest running dropzone.

options.name: Weekday Tandem Skydive
options.detail: Tandem jump during the week at a discounted rate; must jump during weekday.

options.name: Student - Military Discount Tandem
options.detail: Discount for active student or military ID holders; cannot be combined with other discounts.

options.name: Group Discount 5-14 Jumpers
options.detail: Group of 5-14 jumpers get a discounted price; cannot be combined with other discounts.

blurb: Guests experience tandem skydiving from up to 14,000 ft with views of Long Island Sound, CT River, and Hartford. The student program includes a 6-8 hour ground class preparing for a first solo skydive. Winter operations are available with limited services and require an A license to jump.
extraNote: Weekday discount and group discounts cannot be combined with other discounts · Winter operations subject to weather; call or check Facebook for closures · Heated clubhouse on the other side of the airport during winter; driveway across from the Airport sign, not the skydiving sign.
